headline: Bitcoin steadied near $65,000 on Sunday after a slide to about $62,000, its lowest since July, and is heading for its steepest weekly drop since June as money keeps leaving crypto funds.

market.asOf: Read at about 11:55 UTC Sun 15 Nov (18:55 Bangkok): BTC from Binance.US (Coinlore showed $65,447, -2.7%), ETH from Coinlore, SOL from CoinGecko. Prices move fast; use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Extreme fear: the Alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index's latest daily reading was 13 out of 100 (Extreme Fear).

stories.title: Bitcoin bounces back near $65,000 after hitting about $62,000, but is on track for its worst week since June
stories.summary: Bitcoin slid to its weakest level since July in Asian trading on Sunday as traders who had borrowed to bet on rising prices were forced out automatically. It recovered within hours, but it is still heading for one of its biggest weekly losses of the year. The weekly price candle closes at 00:00 UTC Monday (07:00 Bangkok).
points: Bitcoin's 24-hour low was $62,080.91 on CoinGecko data and it later recovered above $65,000, per Cointelegraph; Coinbase's low was $61,946, per CryptoTicker.

Bitcoin is down nearly 15% over seven days, per Cointelegraph. The week opened at $74,757, and at about $64,800 the weekly loss would be 13.4%, the steepest since the week of 1 June, per CryptoTicker.
About $2B of crypto bets were liquidated (force-closed), including $774M in bitcoin and $488M in ether, per Coinglass data cited by Investing.com; ether's low was $1,711.
Strategy, the biggest company holder, has 850,364 BTC valued at about $54.8B against a cost of $64.16B, so its stack is now worth less than it paid, per Investing.com.

sources.label: CryptoTicker: overnight low and weekly close
Investing.com via Yahoo Finance: liquidations and Strategy

stories.title: Money keeps leaving crypto: ETF withdrawals, shrinking stablecoins, and XRP below $1
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs, the way many Americans hold bitcoin in a brokerage account, lost more than $1B for a second week. The supply of stablecoins, the digital dollars traders keep ready to buy coins, is shrinking fast. Both mean fewer buyers in the market.
points: Spot bitcoin ETFs had $1.07B of net outflows last week and spot ether ETFs lost $398.9M, their seventh straight losing week, per The Block.
All US crypto ETFs together lost about $1.55B on the week; Avalanche funds were the only category with an inflow, per The Block.
BlackRock's IBIT has had outflows for 11 straight sessions, per Cointelegraph.
Stablecoin supply fell $17B over the last month, the steepest drop since 2022, per Glassnode data cited by CoinDesk; USDT and USDC together are worth $244B, the lowest since September 2025.
XRP fell to 89 cents, its lowest since November 2024, per CoinDesk.

stories.title: Rate-hike bets and Anthropic's giant stock listing hang over the week
stories.summary: Futures traders are positioned for the Fed to raise rates, and the Fed's October minutes land on Wednesday. Anthropic's huge share sale prices the same day. These are market bets, not decisions.
points: Futures show 88% of the market positioned for a quarter-point Fed rate hike and the rest for a half-point hike, after hotter-than-expected October inflation, per Trading Economics.
Anthropic plans to sell up to $64.4B of shares at $70 to $78 each, pricing on Wednesday 18 November and trading on Nasdaq under ANT from Thursday 19 November, per StockAnalysis.
Demand for the Anthropic shares is "multiple times" the shares on offer, per StockAnalysis citing Bloomberg.

briefs.title: Korean exchange Coinone reports a customer data breach
briefs.summary: Coinone said a breach at an outsourced support vendor may have exposed customer details, including ID and bank account numbers, but found no evidence of a direct compromise of wallets, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Kava Lend hacked for about $3.8M
briefs.summary: An attacker drained about 55.2M KAVA through a dormant BUSD market, and the KAVA token fell nearly 40%, per The Block.

briefs.title: US moves to seize over $1.2B from the Binance hack
briefs.summary: A court approved the Justice Department's move to seize or restrain more than $1.2B stolen in the Binance hack, which it tied to North Korea, per The Block.

briefs.title: White House names new SEC and CFTC nominees
briefs.summary: The White House picked new nominees for seats at the SEC and the CFTC, the two main US markets regulators, per The Block.

briefs.title: Solana network to link with DTCC's tokenization service
briefs.summary: The DTCC's tokenization service plans to connect with Solana in the second half of 2027, per Solana's latest news post.

briefs.title: stUSDT winds down after a $2.3B peak
briefs.summary: The real-world-asset token stUSDT is closing, with about $8.6M left versus a $2.3B peak; redemptions run until 14 May 2027, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: A bigger bitcoin options expiry lands on 27 November
briefs.summary: About 88,000 BTC (roughly $5.7B) of options expire on Friday 27 November, far larger than this Friday's weekly expiry, per CryptoTicker.
